description: This file defines an interface and related classes for transactional state storage within Orleans. It includes methods for loading and storing transactional states, as well as classes representing the state of pending transactions and storage responses.

classes.name: PendingTransactionState
classes.description: Represents the state of a pending transaction, including sequence ID, transaction ID, timestamp, associated transaction manager, and the state snapshot.

classes.name: TransactionalStorageLoadResponse
classes.description: Represents the response from loading transactional storage, including etag, committed state, sequence ID, metadata, and list of pending states.

classes.name: TransactionalStateMetaData
classes.description: Stores metadata for transactional state, including timestamp and commit records.

classes.name: CommitRecord
classes.description: Records commit timestamp and participating write participants for a transaction.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the transactional storage state, returning a response containing current state and metadata.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Asynchronously stores transactional state with optional concurrency controls and transaction management features.

calls: Task<string> Store(string expectedETag, TransactionalStateMetaData metadata, List<PendingTransactionState<TState>> statesToPrepare, long? commitUpTo, long? abortAfter)
